senses.gloss:
औरभ्र औरभ्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. उर-भ्र),
belonging to or produced from a ram or sheep; (अस्),
m. a coarse woollen blanket; N. of a physician; (अम्),
n. mutton, the flesh of sheep; woollen cloth.
औरभ्रक, अम्, n. a flock of sheep.

औरभ्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to, produced by,
&c., sheep; (अस्), m. a shepherd.

औरश औरश, अस्, m. (fr. उरशा), an in-
habitant of Uraśā.

औरस 1. औरस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. उरस्), be-
longing to or being in the breast; produced from
the breast, i. e. the seat of manly strength, produced
by one's self; legitimate; (अस्, ई), m. f. a legitimate
child, i. e. one by a wife of the same caste.

औरस 2. औरस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. उरशा or
उरसा), coming from Urasā.

औरस्क, अस्, ई, अम्, excellent, distinguished; [cf.
उरस्य.]

औरस्य (?), belonging to or being in the breast;
legitimate.
